name: Extension Reference Field
description: Define a field type for extensions (modules/themes/profiles).
project_description: Extension Reference Field provides a single new field type, 'extension_reference' (label "Extension"), that stores a reference to a Drupal extension by its machine name. Every extension type is supported: modules, themes and installation profiles. A storage-level setting picks which extension type the field targets and which status (enabled, disabled, or all) the selectable options are drawn from. The field ships a select widget (extending core's OptionsSelectWidget, multi-value capable) and a label formatter that renders the extension's human-readable name, optionally linked to its drupal.org project page when the extension carries drupal.org packaging metadata. A computed 'extension' property resolves the stored machine name to a core Extension object on read. There is no settings form, route, permission, or install step of its own; add the field on any fieldable entity via Manage fields.
